Figure 14: Real-robot Task Progress avg 69.1 vs best baseline 49.6

key_settings_evidence: Frozen VideoVAE Encoder/Decoder + N-layer Causal Transformer Block

mechanism_map_evidence: Scale-compressed memory → minute-long streaming under bounded memory
On-policy alignment → reduces action drift (Fig 6) and long-horizon inconsistency
comparison_evidence: Video gen: 5 baselines (InfinityStar, Wan2.1-1.3B, Wan2.2-14B, CogVideoX-5B, Cosmos3-Nano)

limitations_evidence: Motion Smoothness -9.8% explained as 'coarse-to-fine 嵌套引入跨尺度抖动'
FPR 0.136 explained as 'evaluator 与 actor 同源时的乐观偏置风险'
Conditional transition bias +0.12 on insertion explained as 'contact-intensive transitions 是世界模型最薄弱环节'
proven_unproven_evidence: Proven: 11/13 视频指标 SOTA, 7 任务平均 69.1 任务进度, 闭环校准 MAE 0.062
Proven but bounded: Action Following 0.290 仍远低于 1.0, 30 cell sample size 仅 N=20
Unproven: 跨 embodiment 迁移, 单卡显存严格受限(<40GB) 表现, evaluator 同源风险
takeaways_evidence: 可复用工程清单: next-scale AR 训练循环 + 4 桶记忆 + Frozen VideoVAE + PPO/GRPO 闭环
可复用模式: 动作信号需要按尺度切片注入而非全局条件
可复用警示: 同策略对齐 evaluator 必须独立于 actor 自身
